source.name: Google
source.basis: Reviews of one branch, not the chain. From a Google Maps page of the 126 Baker St, London branch saved on 2026-11-14, holding 380 of its 1,036 reviews. Topics group the reviews that use related words.
source.averageNote: Stars are those of the reviews that mention it, not a score for the item itself.

restaurant.title: Starbucks, 126 Baker St
restaurant.summary: Guests mostly talk about the staff and the coffee, and like the seating downstairs. The complaints are about cleanliness and prices.
restaurant.say: The Baker Street Starbucks is rated 4.1 out of 5 from 1,036 Google reviews.

cards.text: Reliable Starbucks brew... Friendly staff here and a convenient location on Baker Street. Quiet little area downstairs and a sunny terrace outside... Great place to relax with a coffee
